name: Uniserve Communications Corporation
summary: Uniserve Communications Corporation provides Internet access, telecommunications, and commercial IT consulting services to residential and business customers primarily in British Columbia and Alberta. It offers fiber, internet, long-distance and digital telephone plans, and digital TV services. The company also provides office in a box solution that provides hardware for computers and laptops, phones, all networking equipment, and productivity software; managed services, including managed IT, network, security, back up, and storage, as well as hardware as a service; and colocation and cloud services. Uniserve Communications Corporation was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
